sections.html:
Castle Rock is a home rule town and the county seat of Douglas County, and it is the county's most populous municipality. It sits at the junction of Interstate 25 and State Highway 86, 28 miles south of downtown Denver and 37 miles north of Colorado Springs.

The town lies a few miles east of the Rampart Range on the western edge of the Great Plains, at an elevation of 6,224 feet. It covers about 34.7 square miles and uses a council-manager form of government with a seven-member town council.

sections.h2: How did Castle Rock get its name and start?
sections.html:
The town is named for a castle-shaped butte just north of the town center. Castle Rock was founded in 1874 and incorporated April 14, 1881, and it was chosen as county seat for its central location.

Rhyolite stone, not gold, drove settlement, and quarrying thrived in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The Works Progress Administration built a star on top of the butte in 1936, and the 45-foot electric star is lit every year on the Saturday before Thanksgiving. Voters approved a home rule charter commission in 1984, and the charter was finalized in 1987.

sections.h2: How fast has Castle Rock grown?
sections.html:
Castle Rock grew from 48,231 residents in 2010 to 73,158 in the 2020 census, an increase of 51.68 percent. The estimate for 2025 is 83,815.

Residential building tracked that growth. Single-family permits peaked at 1,169 in 2021, fell to about 685 in 2023 and reached 371 through October 2024. Fewer new permits means new-build competition has eased compared with the 2021 peak.

sections.h2: What is Castle Rock's economy like?
sections.html:
Castle Rock is largely a commuter town: about 80 percent of residents commute out of town for work, and the town has relatively little industrial-zoned land. The largest industry groups are educational services, health care and social assistance at 16.1 percent, professional, scientific and management services at 10.3 percent, and finance, insurance and real estate at 9.7 percent.

AdventHealth Castle Rock is the only hospital. Long commutes along I-25 shape how sellers think about timing, because a job change in Denver or Colorado Springs can mean a move on short notice.

sections.h2: How do you get around Castle Rock?
sections.html:
Castle Rock is built around I-25 and U.S. 87, which run together north to south through town. U.S. 85 meets I-25 at Exit 184, and State Highway 86 enters from the east and becomes Founders Parkway.

Castle Rock is not part of the Regional Transportation District, because voters opted out in November 2005, so there is no RTD bus or light rail service to Denver. The town does run a reduced-fare taxi voucher program and a senior center shuttle. BNSF and Union Pacific freight lines also run through town parallel to U.S. 85.

sections.h2: What is the climate in Castle Rock, and how does it affect a house?
sections.html:
Castle Rock has a semiarid climate with cold, dry, snowy winters and hot, wetter summers. January averages a 45.6 degree high and an 18.0 degree low, July averages an 85.7 degree high, and the record range runs from 102 degrees in July down to 37 below zero in January.

Average annual precipitation is 17.60 inches and average snowfall is 57.5 inches. Roofs, gutters, decks and driveways take that load, and August brings the most rain.

sections.h2: When are Douglas County property taxes due?
sections.html:
Douglas County lets owners pay in two halves or in full. The first half is due by the last day of February, the second half by June 15, and the full payment by April 30. When a date lands on a weekend, the deadline moves to the next business day.

  • Statements go to the owner of record on the tax roll each January.
  • The county says it does not bill mortgage lenders.
  • Not receiving a statement does not excuse a late payment.

Because lenders are not billed, check that an escrow account actually pays the tax. See the Douglas County tax dates page.

The Douglas County School District is based in Castle Rock and operates 18 public schools in town. They include ten elementary schools, two middle schools, two charter schools, one magnet school, one alternative high school and two high schools, Castle View High School and Douglas County High School.

Three private primary schools also operate in town. School boundaries are tied to the address, so ask the district to confirm assignments if a buyer asks.

sections.h2: What steps does a cash sale in Castle Rock follow?
sections.html:
A cash sale in Castle Rock runs through the same title and recording process as a financed sale, without lender underwriting. The steps are:

  1. You share the address and the condition of the house.
  2. We send a written offer for the house as it is.
  3. A title company confirms taxes and liens for the Douglas County parcel.
  4. You close, and the deed is recorded in Douglas County.

If the numbers do not work for you, you can walk away with no obligation.

sections.h2: What do Castle Rock sellers usually face?
sections.html:
Castle Rock sellers tend to face a need for speed and a house that has aged. Typical situations include:

  • A move for work, with a closing date set by an employer
  • An inherited house that heirs do not want to maintain
  • Roof, deck or landscaping wear after snowy winters and drought rules
  • An owner who wants to avoid showings and negotiation

A cash purchase removes the lender and the appraisal. It does not change what you owe on the property, so ask the title company for payoff and tax figures before you commit.

faqs.q: What county is Castle Rock, CO in?
faqs.a: Castle Rock is in Douglas County and is its county seat.

faqs.q: When is the full property tax payment due in Castle Rock?
faqs.a: April 30 under Douglas County's schedule. Half payments are due the last day of February and June 15.

faqs.q: Is there public transit from Castle Rock to Denver?
faqs.a: Castle Rock is not part of the Regional Transportation District, so there is no RTD bus or light rail service, according to the town's published description.

faqs.q: How many schools does Douglas County School District run in Castle Rock?
faqs.a: The district is based in Castle Rock and operates 18 public schools in town, including Castle View High School and Douglas County High School.

faqs.q: Can I sell my Castle Rock house without fixing it up?
faqs.a: Yes. A cash buyer purchases as-is, so you do not need to repair the roof, yard or interior first. Get the offer in writing and compare it with a listing.
